newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate down to 9.1 pct from 10.1.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate down to 9.1 pct from 10.1.

text.p: Croatian average lending rate fell to 9.1 percent on Thursday from 10.1 percent weighed down by meagre supply of kuna funds.
Dealers said demand at 50 million could not be met as banks sought more funds for pre-Christmas cash spending. All 14.8 million kuna on offer were used in daily trade.
New borrowings accounted for 12.8 million kuna most of which were done at a steady call money rate of 9.0 percent. A smaller term loan was struck at 15 percent.
Insurers rolled over an old 11-15 day loan at 9.0 percent.
The central bank calculated its kuan midrates for Friday slightly weaker at 5.5376 against the dollar and at 3.5577 versus the German mark. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
